notes.title: MAC SUPPORT - Update notes for 29 July 2023
notes.notes:
MAC SUPPORT ADDED
- 2.5% of Steam users are using Mac devices according to random article on the internet. So I didn't want to exempt them from playing this epic game! :)

16:10 RATIO SUPPORT ADDED
- Most Mac devices support a 16:10 screen ratio, so naturally, we had to adapt the game to support these resolutions. 
- This also applies to Windows gamers.

notes.title: 1 week since the release! - Mr. Mat Hematic
notes.notes:
Data
1 week has passed since the release of Mr. Mat Hematic, my first Steam game, and here are the results:
Reviews: 20+ (Mostly Positive)
Unique players: 600+
Average daily active users: 80+
Impressions: 1M+
Visits: 20k+

Mentions in some websites: 
1) https://www.riotbits.com/mr-mat-hematic/
2) https://re-actor.net/mr-mat-hematic-how-to-find-secret-level-malades-miwqa-achievement/

Overall
I would also like to mention that this game started as a 1-week game jam hosted by GameDev.tv. So overall with no marketing budget and no intention of making this game big, I think this game was a decent experience for me as a first Steam release. I am already thinking of applying this new experience to my upcoming Steam projects. So stay tuned!

If you have any feedback or suggestions I would appreciate it in the comments. 🙂
